resources.string: Local Scan is fully on-device (thumbnails max 384 px, nothing uploaded). The two blue buttons below are the opt-in Colab path: Upload to notebook zips thumbnails to Download/PhotoSorter-Colab and opens a free Colab notebook (NudeNet + vision model, plan.csv, wipe after). Sort imports that plan.csv and sorts from it. Nothing moves or deletes without your approval per category. NSFW explicit captions are shown as [redacted].
